title: Not All Correct Fixes Run Alike: An Empirical Study of Patch Performance in Repository-Level Issue Resolution
title_zh: 并非所有正确的修复方案表现相同：仓库级问题修复中补丁性能的经验研究

paragraphs.en: Repository-level issue-resolution benchmarks such as SWE-bench evaluate submitted patches primarily based on whether they pass the correctness tests, leaving the runtime performance of different test-passing patches largely unexplored. Evaluating patch performance is essential but challenging since designing performance workloads for each benchmark instance is costly. However, these benchmarks already provide a natural candidate: the built-in FAIL_TO_PASS (F2P) tests, which exercise the behavior affected by the issue fix. We therefore investigate whether the provided F2P tests can be repurposed to evaluate patch performance. Overall, we choose four frontier models, Claude Opus 5, GPT 5.6, DeepSeek V4 Pro, and Qwen 3.8 Max, paired with SWE-agent to resolve the pre-filtered measurable corpus from verified splits of SWE-bench and SWE-bench-Live, yielding 262 cases with at least two different correct solutions, including the developer ground-truth patch. We then measure each solution’s runtime performance in instruction count and wall-clock time on the native F2P test, and use Welch ANOVA instead of the RSD proposed in prior work as a more robust statistical discrimination criterion. We find that this methodology exhibits notable discrimination capability in runtime performance and identifies performance differences among patches in almost half of the instances. Our empirical study shows that the runtime performance of generated patches is independent of the issue resolution rate of LLMs, with nearly reversed model rankings. The case study also shows that the performance analysis reveals architectural regression in some patches that the correctness evaluation overlooked. These findings suggest that resolution rate does not adequately characterize LLMs’ capability for repository-level issue resolution, motivating future evaluations to consider patch performance alongside it.
paragraphs.zh: 仓库级问题修复基准测试（如 SWE-bench）主要根据提交的补丁是否通过正确性测试来评估其效果，但不同通过测试的补丁在运行时性能方面的表现却鲜有研究。 评估补丁性能至关重要，但也充满挑战，因为为每个基准测试实例设计性能负载的成本高昂。 然而，这些基准测试已经提供了一个天然的候选方案：内置的 FAIL_TO_PASS（F2P）测试，该测试能够触发受问题修复影响的行为。 因此，我们研究了所提供的 F2P 测试是否可以被重新利用来评估补丁的性能。 总体而言，我们选择了四个前沿模型——Claude Opus 5、GPT 5.6、DeepSeek V4 Pro 和 Qwen 3.8 Max，并与 SWE-agent 结合，对 SWE-bench 和 SWE-bench-Live 经验证分集中的预过滤可测量语料库进行问题修复，最终得到了 262 个至少存在两种不同正确解决方案的案例，其中包含了开发者提供的基准补丁。 接着，我们在原生 F2P 测试中测量了每种解决方案的指令数和实际运行时间等运行时性能指标，并采用 Welch ANOVA 替代先前研究中提出的 RSD，作为更稳健的统计性区分标准。 我们发现，该方法在运行时性能方面展现出显著的区分能力，并在近一半的实例中识别出了补丁之间的性能差异。 我们的实证研究表明，生成补丁的运行时性能与大型语言模型（LLM）的问题修复率无关，且模型排名几乎完全相反。 案例研究还表明，性能分析揭示了一些补丁存在架构层面的性能退化，而正确性评估却未能察觉这些问题。 这些发现表明，修复率不足以全面反映大型语言模型在仓库级问题修复方面的能力，因此未来的评估应将补丁性能与修复率一并纳入考量。

paragraphs.en: Repository-level issue-resolution benchmarks such as SWE-bench ( Jimenez et al., 2024 ) and SWE-bench-Live ( Zhang et al., 2026 ) have become widely used to evaluate the capability of large language models (LLMs) to resolve real-world software issues. For each instance, a solver receives the problem statement, works in the repository at the base commit, and generates a patch. The benchmark then checks whether the applied patch passes the test suites, especially the FAIL_TO_PASS (F2P) tests, which fail on the unfixed repository and pass after the repair, to determine whether the issue is resolved. This evaluation, however, focuses only on functional correctness. Passing the tests does not indicate how efficiently the patch executes: different correct patches may satisfy the same tests while exhibiting substantially different performance costs. Runtime performance is therefore an important dimension of patch quality that current benchmarks fail to capture.
paragraphs.zh: 仓库级别的故障解决基准测试，例如 SWE-bench（Jimenez 等人，2024）和 SWE-bench-Live（Zhang 等人，2026），已被广泛用于评估大型语言模型（LLM）解决现实世界软件问题的能力。 对于每个实例，求解器会接收问题描述，在基础提交版本下的仓库中操作，并生成一个补丁。 随后，该基准测试会检查所应用的补丁是否通过测试套件，特别是 FAIL_TO_PASS（F2P）测试——这些测试在未修复的仓库中失败，但在修复后通过，以此判断问题是否已解决。 然而，这种评估仅关注功能正确性。 通过测试并不意味着补丁执行效率高：不同的正确补丁可能通过相同的测试，但性能成本却存在显著差异。 因此，运行时性能是补丁质量的一个重要维度，而当前的基准测试未能捕捉到这一点。

paragraphs.en: Recently, code performance has drawn increasing attention alongside correctness. However, the research community has not examined the runtime behavior of generated patches for repository issues related to functional correctness. One line of related work evaluates the runtime performance of code generated from functional requirements, primarily at the function or single-file level ( Huang et al., 2024b ; Peng et al., 2025b ; Li et al., 2024 ) . In contrast, our study concerns issue resolution in real-world repositories. The other related line focuses on repository-level code performance optimization ( He et al., 2025 ; Shetty et al., 2026 ; Ma et al., 2026 ) . These studies usually carry performance workloads to measure speedup and aim solely to improve runtime performance rather than repair existing functional issues. Overall, our study differs from both lines of research: we focus on whether LLMs produce genuinely different correct patches for the same repository-level functional issues, particularly in runtime performance.

paragraphs.en: Runtime performance analysis requires workloads to measure the patched code. The repository-level issue-resolution tasks packaged by benchmarks such as SWE-bench, however, provide only test suites for correctness, with none for performance analysis. Nevertheless, we note that the built-in F2P test exercises the exact behavior the fix changes, so running it repeatedly and recording its execution cost seems to provide a free performance evaluation. We therefore investigate whether this F2P test can evaluate the runtime performance of different correct patches and effectively reveal performance differences among them. We build our research corpus from the verified splits of SWE-bench and SWE-bench-Live, through a pre-filtering process that removes the instances unsuitable for performance measurement and retains 339 cases. After that, we employ four frontier LLMs, namely Claude Opus 5 , GPT 5.6 , DeepSeek V4 Pro , and Qwen 3.8 Max , each paired with the widely used SWE-agent framework ( Yang et al., 2024 ) to resolve the retained instances. We then collect the correct patches produced by these models, analyze the diversity and similarity landscape among them and the developer ground-truth patches, and repeatedly run the F2P test on each to record instruction counts and wall-clock times for performance analysis. As the statistical discrimination criterion, we employ the Welch analysis of variance (ANOVA) ( Welch, 1951 ) in place of the Relative Standard Deviation (RSD) proposed by prior work ( Peng et al., 2025b ) , considering that the latter ignores the within-solution variance and is therefore not robust enough, especially when the number of solutions under comparison varies across cases, or when several solutions form closely related subgroups.
paragraphs.zh: 运行时性能分析需要工作负载来衡量已打补丁的代码。 然而，像 SWE-bench 这样的基准测试所打包的仓库级问题解决任务仅提供正确性测试套件，而没有用于性能分析的测试套件。 尽管如此，我们注意到内置的 F2P 测试正好检验了修复所改变的行为，因此重复运行该测试并记录其执行成本似乎可以免费获得性能评估。 因此，我们研究这个 F2P 测试是否能够评估不同正确补丁的运行时性能，并有效揭示它们之间的性能差异。 我们通过预过滤过程从 SWE-bench 和 SWE-bench-Live 的已验证分集中构建研究语料库，该过程移除了不适合性能测量的实例，保留了 339 个案例。 之后，我们采用四种前沿 LLM，即 Claude Opus 5、GPT 5.6、DeepSeek V4 Pro 和 Qwen 3.8 Max，每种模型都与广泛使用的 SWE-agent 框架（Yang et al., 2024）结合，以解决保留的实例。 接着，我们收集这些模型生成的正确补丁，分析它们之间以及与开发者真实补丁之间的多样性和相似性分布，并对每个补丁重复运行 F2P 测试，记录指令计数和实际运行时间以进行性能分析。 作为统计判别标准，我们采用韦尔奇方差分析（ANOVA）（Welch, 1951），而非先前研究（Peng et al., 2025b）提出的相对标准差（RSD），因为后者忽略了解决方案内部的方差，因此不够稳健，尤其是在比较的解决方案数量因案例而异，或当多个解决方案形成密切相关的子群时。

paragraphs.en: Our empirical study yields the following findings. First , in the filtered corpus, 77.29% of instances have multiple different correct patches under static comparison, indicating the widespread solution diversity across LLMs and the ground truth. Second , the F2P tests provide meaningful discrimination signals for runtime performance: in 41.98% and 34.73% of cases, different solutions exhibit statistically significant performance differences in instruction count and wall-clock time, respectively, suggesting that the F2P tests could serve as a proper starting point for performance analysis. Third , the discrimination criteria of Welch ANOVA and RSD show inconsistent detection behavior, and the latter is likely to overlook cases with genuine runtime differences while retaining cases without meaningful distinctions. Fourth , the resolution rate of issues and the runtime performance of the generated patches are essentially uncorrelated for the compared LLMs, with nearly reversed model rankings:

sents.zh: 首先，在过滤后的语料库中，77.29% 的实例在静态比较下存在多个不同的正确补丁，这表明大型语言模型与真实答案之间存在广泛多样的解决方案。

sents.en: Second , the F2P tests provide meaningful discrimination signals for runtime performance: in 41.98% and 34.73% of cases, different solutions exhibit statistically significant performance differences in instruction count and wall-clock time, respectively, suggesting that the F2P tests could serve as a proper starting point for performance analysis.
sents.zh: 其次，F2P 测试为运行时性能提供了有意义的区分信号：在 41.98% 和 34.73% 的案例中，不同解决方案在指令计数和实际运行时间上分别表现出具有统计学显著性的性能差异，这表明 F2P 测试可以成为性能分析的合适起点。

sents.en: Third , the discrimination criteria of Welch ANOVA and RSD show inconsistent detection behavior, and the latter is likely to overlook cases with genuine runtime differences while retaining cases without meaningful distinctions.
sents.zh: 第三，Welch ANOVA 和 RSD 的区分标准显示出不一致的检测行为，后者可能会忽略存在真实运行时差异的案例，同时保留没有明显区别的案例。

sents.en: Fourth , the resolution rate of issues and the runtime performance of the generated patches are essentially uncorrelated for the compared LLMs, with nearly reversed model rankings:
sents.zh: 第四，对于所比较的大型语言模型而言，问题解决率与生成补丁的运行时性能基本无关，且模型排名几乎完全相反：

paragraphs.en: For the issue resolution rates, Claude (87.32%) ≫ \gg Qwen (83.19%) > > GPT (82.01%) ≈ \approx DeepSeek (81.42%);
paragraphs.zh: 在问题解决率方面，Claude（87.32%）≫ \gg Qwen（83.19%）> > GPT（82.01%）≈ \approx DeepSeek（81.42%）；

paragraphs.en: For the speedup against the ground truth, GPT (97.53%) ≈ \approx DeepSeek (97.89%) > > Claude (98.42%) ≫ \gg Qwen (101.68%), with the smaller the better;
paragraphs.zh: 在相对于基准真实值的加速方面，GPT（97.53%）≈ DeepSeek（97.89%）> Claude（98.42%）≫ Qwen（101.68%），数值越小越好；

paragraphs.en: For the rate of producing the fastest solution, DeepSeek (26.3%) > > GPT (24.7%) ≫ \gg Qwen (15.3%) > > Claude (15.0%), against 18.7% of the ground truth.
paragraphs.zh: 在生成最快解决方案的速度方面，DeepSeek（26.3%）> > GPT（24.7%）≫ \gg Qwen（15.3%）> > Claude（15.0%），而基准真相的速率为 18.7%。

paragraphs.en: The model with the highest resolution rate produces only the third-most efficient patches, and the developer ground-truth patches show no systematic performance advantage over model-generated patches. Lastly , the case study shows that performance comparisons reveal architectural regressions that correctness evaluation cannot detect: three repair strategies vary performance by more than twice, and the two costly ones silently reintroduce the heavy dependency the developer deliberately removed. Based on these findings, we call for future research to focus not only on issue-resolution rates but also on the performance of generated patches for real-world repository issues.
paragraphs.zh: 分辨率最高的模型仅能生成效率排名第三的补丁，而开发者提供的基准补丁在性能上并未表现出相对于模型生成补丁的系统性优势。 最后，该案例研究表明，性能对比揭示了正确性评估无法检测到的架构退化：三种修复策略的性能差异超过两倍，且其中两种成本较高的策略会悄无声息地重新引入开发者刻意移除的重依赖问题。 基于这些发现，我们呼吁未来的研究不仅要关注问题分辨率，还要关注为真实世界代码库中的问题所生成补丁的性能表现。

paragraphs.en: This paper makes the following contributions:
paragraphs.zh: 本文做出了以下贡献：

paragraphs.en: An empirical study of runtime performance for LLM-generated patches. We conduct a large-scale empirical study of correct patches generated by LLMs and by developers. We investigate whether LLMs produce essentially different correct patches, particularly in runtime performance, for repository-level functional issue resolution, and we answer this question on two SWE-bench-family benchmarks with four frontier LLMs using the established agent framework.

paragraphs.en: In this study, we analyze patch performance in repository-level issue-resolution benchmarks. The most widely used benchmark is SWE-bench ( Jimenez et al., 2024 ) , which harvests real issues and their resolving pull requests from popular open-source Python repositories. SWE-bench-Live ( Zhang et al., 2026 ) updates continuously with more recent pull requests created after the knowledge cutoffs of contemporary models, mitigating data contamination. We conduct our study using the verified splits of both benchmarks.
paragraphs.zh: 在本研究中，我们分析了智能体在仓库级问题解决基准测试中的表现。 最广泛使用的基准测试是 SWE-bench（Jimenez 等人，2024），它从热门的开源 Python 仓库中收集真实问题及其对应的解决拉取请求。 SWE-bench-Live（Zhang 等人，2026）会持续更新，纳入在当代模型知识截止日之后创建的更近期的拉取请求，从而减轻数据污染问题。 我们使用这两个基准测试的已验证分片开展研究。

paragraphs.en: Each instance in these benchmarks corresponds to a real-world repository-level issue. It includes a problem statement describing the reported issue, a base commit specifying the repository state before the fix, the developer’s gold patch, and a test patch containing the F2P tests that encode the expected behavior, along with a PASS_TO_PASS (P2P) regression test suite. Each instance also includes a pre-built Docker execution environment in which the submitted patch is applied, and the tests are executed. To address an instance, a solver reads the problem statement, operates in the repository at the base commit, and submits a diff patch; the official evaluation infrastructure applies the patch and runs the test suite. An instance is considered resolved if all F2P tests pass while the P2P regression tests remain passing.
paragraphs.zh: 这些基准测试中的每个实例都对应一个真实世界中的仓库级问题。 它包含一个描述所报告问题的陈述、一个指定修复前仓库状态的基线提交、开发者的黄金补丁，以及一个包含编码预期行为的 F2P 测试的测试补丁，同时还附带一个 PASS_TO_PASS (P2P) 回归测试套件。 每个实例还包含一个预构建的 Docker 执行环境，提交的补丁将在其中应用，测试也将在此环境中执行。 要解决某个实例，求解器需要读取问题陈述，在基线提交对应的仓库中操作并提交一个差异补丁；官方评估基础设施将应用该补丁并运行测试套件。 如果所有 F2P 测试都通过，且 P2P 回归测试仍然通过，则视为该实例已解决。

paragraphs.en: The central correctness criterion is the F2P test itself. It fails on the unfixed repository and passes only after the issue is repaired. The task is therefore test-driven; correctness is mainly determined by whether the submitted patch passes the F2P test, rather than by whether it reproduces the developer’s reference patch. The evaluation criterion only requires that the issue be fixed, not the specific implementation used to achieve it. So multiple genuinely different patches may pass the same F2P tests. These alternative fixes can exhibit measurably different performance once applied to the repository. This performance dimension is invisible to the correctness protocol, yet real and varying across admissible fixes, and the benchmark provides no direct way to observe it.
paragraphs.zh: 核心正确性标准就是 F2P 测试本身。 它在未修复的仓库中会失败，只有在问题修复后才会通过。 因此，这项任务是测试驱动的；正确性主要由提交的补丁是否通过 F2P 测试决定，而不是由它是否复现了开发者的参考补丁决定。 评估标准仅要求问题得到修复，并不要求特定的实现方式。 因此，多个真正不同的补丁都可能会通过相同的 F2P 测试。 这些替代修复方案在应用于仓库后，可能会表现出可测量的性能差异。 这一性能维度在正确性协议中是不可见的，但它确实存在，并且在所有可接受的修复方案中各不相同，而基准测试无法直接观察到它。

paragraphs.en: An intuitive way to measure performance, however, appears readily available. The F2P test exercises exactly the behavior affected by the fix changes and therefore serves as an approximate stress workload. By repeatedly executing the test under instrumentation, we can collect performance metrics during execution and evaluate each patch on each benchmark instance without requiring additional artifacts. Note that the benchmark also provides the P2P suite to guard against correctness regressions; however, we do not extend performance measurement to it. The P2P tests typically far outnumber the F2P ones, and most do not exercise the issue-fixed code path. Including them would multiply the cost while contributing little to the performance analysis.
paragraphs.zh: 然而，一种直观的性能衡量方法似乎唾手可得。 F2P 测试恰好针对修复变更所影响的行为进行检验，因此可用作近似的压力工作负载。 通过在带监控工具的条件下重复执行该测试，我们可以在执行过程中收集性能指标，并无需额外产物即可在每次基准测试实例中评估每个补丁。 请注意，该基准测试也提供了 P2P 套件以防止正确性回归；不过，我们没有将其纳入性能测量范围。 P2P 测试的数量通常远多于 F2P 测试，而且大多数测试并不会触发已修复问题的代码路径。 将它们包含在内会增加成本，但对性能分析的帮助却微乎其微。

sents.en: Including them would multiply the cost while contributing little to the performance analysis.
sents.zh: 将它们包含在内会增加成本，但对性能分析的帮助却微乎其微。

paragraphs.en: We acknowledge that an F2P test typically combines data preparation, invocation of the tested behavior, and assertion in a single body, so measuring the whole test captures all three phases, while only the invocation is patch-sensitive. However, in the ideal case, data preparation and assertion cost the same for every solution. Thus, including them shifts every solution’s cost by the same amount, diluting the measured differences without biasing the comparison. In reality, the execution introduces run-to-run noise, while the measurement protocol averages it out through repeated executions, so it favors no solution. As a result, the ordering among solutions still remains trustworthy when the difference is statistically significant. The residual effect of noise is confined only to solutions whose costs are close, where a raw reading cannot tell whether the gap is real.
paragraphs.zh: 我们承认，F2P 测试通常将数据准备、受测行为的调用以及断言整合在同一个主体中，因此测量整个测试可以涵盖这三个阶段，而只有行为调用部分对补丁敏感。 然而，在理想情况下，数据准备和断言在所有解决方案中的成本是相同的。 因此，将它们纳入计算会使每个解决方案的成本增加相同的量，从而稀释测得差异，而不会使比较产生偏差。 实际上，执行过程会引入每次运行之间的噪声，而测量协议通过重复执行将其平均化，因此不会对任何解决方案产生偏好。 结果就是，当差异具有统计显著性时，各解决方案之间的排序仍然值得信赖。 噪声的残余影响仅局限于成本相近的解决方案，在这些情况下，原始读数无法判断差异是否真实存在。

paragraphs.en: In practice, however, not every instance supports this straightforward usage. During corpus construction, we therefore impose three constraints on the instances. First, the F2P test must constitute a single unit of measurement, so that measurement yields one comparable reading per instance. Second, it must sustain repeated execution within one process to suppress run-to-run noise. Third, it must be free of input and output operations, whose variance would drown out the CPU-level signals the measurement relies on. We filter the datasets against these constraints, using one static rule for the first and dynamic probing for the latter two, and retain 339 instances as our corpus.
paragraphs.zh: 然而在实践中，并非每个实例都支持这种直接用法。 因此，在语料库构建过程中，我们对这些实例施加了三项约束。 首先，F2P 测试必须构成一个单一测量单元，以便每次测量都能为每个实例产生一个可比较的读数。 其次，它必须能在单个进程内持续重复执行，以抑制运行之间的噪声。 第三，它必须不包含任何输入和输出操作，因为这些操作的变异性会掩盖测量所依赖的 CPU 级信号。 我们根据这些约束对数据集进行筛选：对前两项使用一条静态规则，对后两项则采用动态探测，最终保留了 339 个实例作为我们的语料库。

paragraphs.en: In-process repeatability. Conventional performance evaluation organizes execution at two levels: the inner loop repeats the measured function to accumulate signal, lifting the measurement quantity above the noise floor, and the outer loop repeats that process as independent replicates to expose run-to-run variation ( Georges et al., 2007 ) . In-process repetition is essential, since a single execution of the F2P test is typically very fast and cannot yield an accurate measurement on its own. The test must therefore support repeated execution within a single process; a test that breaks under repetition cannot be measured, and is excluded.
paragraphs.zh: 过程内重复性。 传统的性能评估将执行组织为两个层次：内循环重复测量函数以累积信号，使测量值高于噪声底限；外循环则将这一过程作为独立的重复试验进行重复，以揭示每次运行之间的差异（Georges 等，2007）。 过程内的重复至关重要，因为 F2P 测试的单次执行通常非常快，无法单独得出准确的测量结果。 因此，该测试必须支持在单个过程内的重复执行；任何在重复过程中会失效的测试都无法进行测量，因而被排除在外。

paragraphs.en: Both rules demand executing the F2P test and analyzing its behavior. The benchmark provides each instance’s native test command and its test identifiers. Appending the F2P identifier to the native command runs exactly that test as a single point, so probing reuses the official execution infrastructure throughout. On top of it, we devise a decorator-based probing method that exploits a Python language feature. It requires no modification to the test’s own logic, keeping our method generic across the benchmark’s diverse repositories (shown in Fig. 1 ).
paragraphs.zh: 这两条规则都要求执行 F2P 测试并分析其行为。 该基准测试为每个实例提供其原生测试命令和测试标识符。 将 F2P 标识符附加到原生命令上，即可作为单个点运行该测试，因此探测过程在整个过程中复用了官方的执行基础设施。 此外，我们还设计了一种基于装饰器的探测方法，该方法利用了 Python 语言的一项特性。 这种方法无需修改测试本身的逻辑，从而使我们能够在基准测试中各种不同的代码库（如图 1 所示）中通用使用。

paragraphs.en: Specifically, for each instance, we first locate its F2P function in the test file that includes it and insert a predefined decorator on the function definition. The decorated function therefore runs our injected logic whenever it is invoked. Within the decorator, the F2P function is first executed repeatedly, 10 times in a plain loop, as a warm-up, ensuring that the subsequent execution is in a steady state (for example, with lazy imports already absorbed). The decorator then executes the F2P function once more, and, immediately before and after this single invocation, writes a distinctive marker line directly to the standard error stream through a system call.
paragraphs.zh: 具体来说，对于每个实例，我们首先在其包含该实例的测试文件中定位其 F2P 函数，并在函数定义处插入一个预定义的装饰器。 因此，经过装饰的函数在每次被调用时都会执行我们注入的逻辑。 在装饰器内部，F2P 函数首先通过一个简单的循环重复执行 10 次作为预热，以确保后续的执行处于稳定状态（例如，懒加载的导入项已经处理完毕）。 然后，装饰器再次执行一次 F2P 函数，并且在这单次调用的前后，立即通过系统调用将一条独特的标记行直接写入标准错误流。

paragraphs.en: Before each execution, we restore the repository to the base commit and apply the ground-truth patch and the test patch, so the F2P test runs in its passing state. We then run the benchmark’s single-point command under strace 1 1 1 https://strace.io , a tool for tracing system calls. (in practice, by prepending the strace keyword to the command), and all the system calls produced during the execution are written to a log file. We exclude any instance that cannot sustain in-process repeated execution and therefore fails to collect the required log. For the instances that run through, we analyze the log and, guided by the distinctive marker, precisely locate the window of the last F2P invocation and extract the system calls it produced. Over these calls, we empirically construct a classifier and determine whether the execution involves I/O operations, and exclude any instances that do.

paragraphs.en: In summary, filtering the raw datasets with the static rule and the dynamic probing yields a corpus of 339 instances on which the rest of the study runs (Table 1 ). Among the three filters, the single-test constraint removes the most instances, and SWE-bench-Live loses far more than SWE-bench, consistent with SWE-bench-Live being the harder benchmark indicated by its lower solving rates ( Zhang et al., 2026 ) .
paragraphs.zh: 总而言之，通过静态规则和动态探测对原始数据集进行过滤后，得到了一个包含 339 个实例的语料库，后续研究均基于该语料库展开（表 1）。 在这三种过滤方法中，单次测试约束移除的实例最多，而 SWE-bench-Live 损失的实例远多于 SWE-bench，这与 SWE-bench-Live 因解决率较低而被视为更难基准的情况一致（Zhang et al., 2026）。

sents.en: Among the three filters, the single-test constraint removes the most instances, and SWE-bench-Live loses far more than SWE-bench, consistent with SWE-bench-Live being the harder benchmark indicated by its lower solving rates ( Zhang et al., 2026 ) .
sents.zh: 在这三种过滤方法中，单次测试约束移除的实例最多，而 SWE-bench-Live 损失的实例远多于 SWE-bench，这与 SWE-bench-Live 因解决率较低而被视为更难基准的情况一致（Zhang et al., 2026）。

paragraphs.en: The repeatability rule removes 87 instances whose failures fall into three classes of increasing strictness. The first class cannot be executed under our reproduction setup. These instances fail to pass their tests stably even under the original suite execution because of unreachable external dependencies or dataset pathologies. The second class, going further, cannot be run as a single-point test. It is worth noting that the F2P test itself is not executed as a single-point test in the original benchmark infrastructure; this native infrastructure runs the complete test files, and a log parser then extracts the test outcome to derive the F2P verdict. Because executing the full test suite is impractical for performance measurement, we combine the native command with the F2P identifier into a single-point execution. It turns out to be feasible in the vast majority of instances, with only 12 failing: some instances’ F2P identifier is corrupted, and our reverse derivation still fails to locate them; others fail because they rely on state set by preceding tests in the same file. The third class can be run in single-point but fails under in-process repetition. Their root cause is that each test invocation mutates state that outlives it, and later invocations collide with this residue. The mutated state lives either inside the process, as database rows inserted or caches accumulated, or outside it, as filesystem artifacts and server threads left behind. The collision may surface immediately on the next invocation, or after the accumulated state crosses a threshold. The injected decorator’s warm-up loop screens out exactly these instances.
paragraphs.zh: 可重复性规则移除了 87 个实例，这些实例的失败属于三个严格程度递增的类别。 在我们的重新执行设置下，第一类实例无法被执行。 由于无法访问的外部依赖或数据集异常，这些实例即使在原始测试套件执行中也无法稳定通过测试。 更进一步地看，第二类实例无法作为单点测试运行。 值得注意的是，在原始基准测试基础设施中，F2P 测试本身并非作为单点测试执行的；该原生基础设施会运行完整的测试文件，然后由日志解析器提取测试结果以得出 F2P 判定。 由于执行完整的测试套件对于性能测量来说不切实际，我们将原生命令与 F2P 标识符结合为一次单点执行。 事实证明，在绝大多数实例中这是可行的，只有 12 个实例失败：部分实例的 F2P 标识符已损坏，我们的反向推导仍无法定位它们；另一些实例则因依赖同一文件中先前测试设置的状态而失败。 第三类实例可以单点运行，但在进程内重复执行时会失败。 其根本原因是每次测试调用都会改变超出该调用本身生存周期的状态，而后续调用会与这些残留状态发生冲突。 被改变的状态可能存在于进程内部，例如已插入的数据库行或累积的缓存；也可能存在于进程外部，例如文件系统中的残留物或服务器中遗留的线程。 这种冲突可能在下次调用时立即显现，也可能在累积状态超过某个阈值后出现。 注入的装饰器中的预热循环恰好能筛选出这些实例。

paragraphs.en: The I/O-free rule is the second largest source of exclusions, removing 206 instances. We examine the 10 largest contributing repositories and find that they mainly fall into two classes. The first class consists of repositories whose domain is I/O itself, where the tested behavior literally performs file or network operations, such as validating configuration files ( cfn-lint ), rendering PDF documents ( WeasyPrint ), resolving packages ( conan ), extracting media streams ( yt-dlp and streamlink ), and scanning infrastructure definitions ( checkov ). The second class consists of general-purpose repositories such as django , sphinx , pytest , and pylint ; their tested behavior can be pure computation, but the test scaffolding around it usually performs I/O to build up the environment, such as seeding databases, writing build artifacts, or creating temporary files. In these cases, the I/O is a side effect rather than what the test verifies. Because our instrument measures the F2P test as one whole unit, we exclude these instances as well.
paragraphs.zh: 无 I/O 规则是第二大排除原因，排除了 206 个实例。 我们研究了贡献最大的 10 个仓库，发现它们主要可分为两类。 第一类是领域本身与 I/O 相关的仓库，其中受测行为实际上执行了文件或网络操作，例如验证配置文件（cfn-lint）、渲染 PDF 文档（WeasyPrint）、解析包（conan）、提取媒体流（yt-dlp 和 streamlink）以及扫描基础设施定义（checkov）。 第二类是通用型仓库，如 django、sphinx、pytest 和 pylint；它们的受测行为可以是纯粹的计算操作，但围绕该行为的测试框架通常会执行 I/O 来构建环境，例如初始化数据库、写入构建产物或创建临时文件。 在这些情况下，I/O 是副作用，而非测试所验证的内容。 由于我们的工具将 F2P 测试视为一个整体单元，因此我们也排除了这些实例。

paragraphs.en: On the constructed corpus, we employ the widely used SWE-agent framework ( Yang et al., 2024 ) (the lightweight mini-SWE-agent variant 2 2 2 https://github.com/SWE-agent/mini-swe-agent ), together with four state-of-the-art LLMs, Claude Opus 5 , GPT 5.6 , DeepSeek V4 Pro , and Qwen 3.8 Max (referred to as Claude, GPT, DeepSeek, and Qwen hereafter) 3 3 3 GPT is the sol version and DeepSeek is the 0813 snapshot. All agent trajectories were produced on August 17–18, 2026. , to repair each instance under the official execution protocol with a step limit of 250. We select the strongest flagship models each provider currently offers to yield as many correct solution patches from different models as possible, and to keep the subsequent analysis on the current frontier rather than outdated models. Table 2 reports resolution rates; correctness is graded by the official benchmark evaluation infrastructure. We find that Claude achieves the highest resolution rate on both datasets, while DeepSeek is the lowest. Overall, the correctness ordering is Claude ≫ \gg Qwen > > GPT ≈ \approx DeepSeek . Correctness reflects a model’s ability to repair issues, and we examine whether this ability diverges from the runtime performance of the patches the model generates.

paragraphs.en: We then collect all correct patches generated by LLMs and analyze their consistency and diversity. We merge identical patches, since they naturally induce no difference in runtime performance. We define identity by normalized source files rather than raw patches. Specifically, we first apply each patch to the repository at the base commit, discard its modifications to test files following the evaluation protocol ( Jimenez et al., 2024 ; Zhang et al., 2026 ) , and sort out the modified files. We parse each modified Python file into an abstract syntax tree, then unparse it back into canonical form, removing comments, docstrings, formatting, and layout differences. We compare non-code files as-is, since no prior evidence suggests they do not affect execution behavior. We treat two patches as the same solution when all their resulting files are equal under this normalization.
paragraphs.zh: 接着，我们收集所有由大型语言模型生成的正确补丁，并分析其一致性和多样性。 我们将相同的补丁进行合并，因为它们自然不会对运行时性能产生任何差异。 我们通过归一化的源文件而非原始补丁来定义同一性。 具体来说，我们首先将每个补丁应用于基础提交处的代码库，按照评估协议（Jimenez et al., 2024；Zhang et al., 2026）丢弃其对测试文件的修改，并整理出被修改的文件。 我们将每个被修改的 Python 文件解析为抽象语法树，然后将其反解析回规范形式，同时移除注释、文档字符串、格式和布局差异。 对于非代码文件，我们直接按原样进行比较，因为没有先前的证据表明它们不会影响执行行为。 当所有通过这种归一化处理后得到的文件完全一致时，我们将两个补丁视为相同的解决方案。

paragraphs.en: We include the developer’s ground-truth patch as one of the solutions compared for each case. Fig. 2 summarizes the consistency analysis. Each cell corresponds to a pair of sources with the cases that both sources resolved as its base, and reports the fraction of that base on which the two sources submit identical patches. Fig. 2 first shows that patch identity between models is common; every pair of models submits identical patches on a non-negligible fraction of their commonly resolved cases, with GPT and DeepSeek the most consistent pair, at 36% on SWE-bench and 37% on SWE-bench-Live. Second, we find that on SWE-bench the model’s identity with the ground truth generally exceeds its identity with other models. For example, Claude coincides with the ground truth on 48% of its resolved cases, well above its identity with any other model; the same holds for GPT and Qwen. In addition, DeepSeek’s identity with the ground truth is also closely behind its identity with GPT. Third, on SWE-bench-Live, the models’ identity with the ground truth generally remains lower than on SWE-bench. A plausible explanation is that SWE-bench-Live is harder than SWE-bench, as its much lower resolution rates indicate (Table 2 ); its tasks may less often admit the simple, direct solutions like SWE-bench tasks do, so the solution space is possibly larger and the models are less likely to converge on the ground-truth fix. The only exception is Qwen, which matches the ground truth in 56% of cases, exceeding any source pair.
paragraphs.zh: 我们将开发人员的真实情况补丁作为每个案例中用于比较的解决方案之一。 图 2 总结了一致性分析结果。 每个单元格对应一对源程序，其中两个源程序都将某些案例识别为其基础案例，并报告这两个源程序在这些基础案例上提交相同补丁的比例。 图 2 首先表明模型之间的补丁一致性很常见；每对模型在其共同解决的案例中，都有相当一部分提交了相同的补丁，其中 GPT 和 DeepSeek 是最一致的一对，在 SWE-bench 上的比例为 36%，在 SWE-bench-Live 上为 37%。 其次，我们发现，在 SWE-bench 上，模型与真实情况的一致性通常高于与其他模型的一致性。 例如，Claude 在其解决的案例中有 48% 与真实情况一致，远高于它与任何其他模型的一致性；GPT 和 Qwen 也是如此。 此外，DeepSeek 与真实情况的一致性也紧随其与 GPT 的一致性之后。 第三，在 SWE-bench-Live 上，模型与真实情况的一致性通常低于 SWE-bench 上的表现。 一个合理的解释是 SWE-bench-Live 比 SWE-bench 更难，因为其解决率明显更低（表 2）；其任务可能较少允许像 SWE-bench 任务那样简单直接的解决方案，因此解决方案空间可能更大，模型也更难收敛到真实情况的修复方案。 唯一的例外是 Qwen，它在 56% 的案例中与真实情况匹配，超过了任何源程序组合。

paragraphs.en: Table 3 shows the distribution of the merged result. We find that 262 cases (77.29%) contain at least two different solutions, and therefore constitute the study corpus, because performance comparison is meaningful only when at least two distinct implementations exist . Table 3 shows that solution diversity is common. In particular, in 11.21% of cases, all four models produce mutually different patches that also differ from the ground-truth patch, resulting in five distinct solutions in each case. paragraphs.en: Each F2P test runs as-is inside its official per-instance Docker environment. The evaluation procedure is organized at two levels ( Georges et al., 2007 ) ; the inner loop repeats the F2P test function N N times within the same process to lift the measured quantity above the noise floor, while the outer loop repeats that process G G times as independent replicates to expose run-to-run variation. We evaluate each distinct solution patch of each case using the same procedure.
paragraphs.zh: 每个 F2P 测试都在其官方的单实例 Docker 环境中按原样运行。 评估流程分为两个层级（Georges 等人，2007）：内循环在同一个进程内重复执行 F2P 测试函数 N 次，以提高测量值相对于噪声底的信噪比；而外循环则将这一过程作为独立的重复实验重复 G 次，以揭示不同运行之间的差异。 我们对每个案例中的每一个独立解决方案补丁都采用相同的流程进行评估。

paragraphs.en: We implement the inner loop with the same decoration mechanism as in the filtering phase (§ 2.2 ), except that we replace the marked pass with an instrumented loop of N N repetitions. A single-point test drives the wrapped test body through a warm-up stage followed by a measurement stage within the same process. During the measurement stage, the F2P function runs N N times under instrumentation, and we sum the recorded metrics over the N N repetitions to form the measurement for one replicate. To keep total work per measurement roughly uniform across cases for dataset-level aggregation, and to suppress the influence of run-to-run noise, we first anchor N N per case during a calibration phase before measurement, letting the measurement of the fastest solution take between 4 and 8 seconds. Technically, we first estimate the time cost of a single execution of the fastest solution with a small number of trial repetitions, derive an initial loop count from that estimate, and then double the count step by step towards the desired N N until the test time falls inside the window. The calibrated N N is large in practice; it averages 6.8 × 10 5 6.8\times 10^{5} invocations per case over the corpus, with a median of 1.6 × 10 4 1.6\times 10^{4} .
paragraphs.zh: 我们在内循环中采用了与过滤阶段（§ 2.2）相同的装饰机制，不同之处在于，我们将标记通过的步骤替换为一个包含 N N 次重复的带仪器监控的循环。 一个单点测试在同一进程内驱动封装后的测试主体，先经过预热阶段，再进入测量阶段。 在测量阶段，F2P 函数在仪器监控下运行 N N 次，我们将记录下来的指标在所有 N N 次重复中求和，从而得到一次复制的测量结果。 为了在数据集级别的汇总中保持每次测量的总工作量在各案例间大致一致，并抑制每次运行之间的噪声影响，我们在测量前的校准阶段首先确定每个案例的 N N 值，并让最快解决方案的测量时间控制在 4 到 8 秒之间。 从技术上看，我们首先通过少量试验性重复来估算最快解决方案单次执行的时间成本，据此推导出初始循环次数，然后逐步将循环次数加倍，直至达到所需的 N N，并使测试时间落入目标区间内。 经过校准的 N N 在实际中数值较大；在整个语料库中，每个案例的平均调用次数为 6.8 × 10^5，中位数为 1.6 × 10^4。

paragraphs.en: We record two performance metrics for every measurement. The first is the instruction count, read from hardware performance counters with the cirron 4 4 4 https://pypi.org/project/cirron/ profiler. The instruction count is insensitive to core contention and frequency scaling, making it a fine-grained measure of the computation actually performed, adopted in prior work ( Peng et al., 2025b ) . The second is the widely used wall-clock time, which captures end-to-end latency including scheduler, memory, and cache effects that instruction counts do not reflect. It is more prone to visible fluctuations under subtle environmental changes ( Peng et al., 2025b ) . The two metrics complement each other, and we report both throughout the paper.
paragraphs.zh: 我们每次测量都会记录两项性能指标。 第一项是指令计数，通过 cirron 4 4 4 https://pypi.org/project/cirron/ 分析器从硬件性能计数器中读取。 指令计数对核心竞争和频率缩放不敏感，因此能够精细衡量实际执行的计算量，这一方法也被先前的研究（Peng et al., 2025b）所采用。 第二项是广泛使用的实际运行时间，它能捕捉端到端的延迟，包括调度器、内存和缓存的影响，而这些是指令计数无法反映的。 在细微的环境变化下，这项指标更容易出现明显的波动（Peng et al., 2025b）。 这两项指标相互补充，我们将在整篇论文中同时报告它们。

paragraphs.en: As this definition shows, RSD captures only the between-solution difference; each solution is represented solely by its replicate mean during the computation, so the within-solution variation never influences the value. We argue that the assessment should exploit every measurement rather than reduce them to a replicate mean. In fact, the RSD-based assessment implicitly assumes that repeated measurements of a solution are fairly stable, an assumption that is fragile in practice, especially when using wall-clock time as the metric. We therefore propose using Welch ANOVA ( Welch, 1951 ) to assess each case with a statistical significance test. Welch ANOVA is a standard statistical tool, commonly used in software engineering research ( Bagherzadeh et al., 2021 ; Dias-Neto and Travassos, 2014 ) . Unlike RSD, Welch ANOVA accounts for within-solution and between-solution variation simultaneously. Another merit is that it generalizes the classical one-way ANOVA to groups with unequal variances, which fits our setting well, since no prior evidence indicates that the case’s different solutions share a common variance.

paragraphs.en: To the best of our knowledge, we are the first to apply Welch ANOVA to the performance analysis of different LLM-generated code patches for repository issue resolution. In summary, Welch ANOVA and the p p -value it produces have four advantages over RSD. First, it weighs the between-solution difference against the within-solution run-to-run variation instead of reporting the former alone. Second, Welch’s adjustment allows the within-solution variance to differ across solutions. Third, RSD is vulnerable to over-split solutions. Static comparison shown in § 2.3 may still leave behaviorally identical patches as different candidates, for example, when the same logic is relocated elsewhere (such as moved into a helper function). Such solutions pull the grand mean toward the subgroups they belong to and shrink the between-solution standard deviation, so RSD likely understates the genuine difference. In contrast, Welch ANOVA tests whether all solution means are equal, a hypothesis that does not depend on how many candidates are identical, and its false-positive rate is controlled at the nominal significance level rather than determined by the number of candidates. Lastly, the two statistics differ in how they respond to the number of solutions. The absolute magnitude of RSD is related to the number of solutions compared in a given case, making it difficult to define a universal RSD threshold across cases. In contrast, Welch ANOVA accounts for the number of groups through the test statistic F W F_{W} and the degrees of freedom in F k − 1 , ν F_{k-1,\nu} , so each case statistic is compared against its matching reference distribution. As a result, it yields a p p -value on a common statistical scale, allowing the same significance level to be applied across cases. Following conventional practice ( Fisher, 1934 ; Wasserstein and Lazar, 2016 ) , we regard a case as exhibiting statistically distinguishable performance on a metric when p < 0.05 p<0.05 . In the following experiments, we compute RSD and p p -value separately for instruction count and wall-clock time.

paragraphs.en: All measurements share the same hardware infrastructure. All run on a server with an Intel Xeon 6982P-C processor (32 physical cores, each with 2 logical cores, 128 GB memory), and each execution runs inside a Docker container on this server. paragraphs.en: We first identify the server’s CPU topology, including the physical cores, their hyperthread siblings, and the NUMA (Non-Uniform Memory Access) nodes. We reserve 2 physical cores for the Docker daemon and 1 core for the operating system, so background activity such as container and image management (fetching images, launching a container, or cleaning it up afterwards) is confined to these reserved CPUs and cannot steal cycles from the measurement cores. As a result, we can parallelize work across multiple groups without coupling their performance to background activity.
paragraphs.zh: 我们首先识别服务器的 CPU 拓扑结构，包括物理核心、它们的超线程兄弟核心以及 NUMA（非均匀内存访问）节点。 我们为 Docker 守护进程保留 2 个物理核心，为操作系统保留 1 个核心，这样容器和镜像管理（如拉取镜像、启动容器或后续清理）等背景活动就被限制在这些预留的 CPU 上，不会占用测量核心的计算资源。 因此，我们可以在多个组之间并行处理任务，而无需将它们的性能与背景活动耦合。

paragraphs.en: We then partition the remaining physical cores into disjoint groups of 4; each group serves 1 measured case. For each group, we create a cgroup v2 5 5 5 https://docs.kernel.org/admin-guide/cgroup-v2.html isolated cpuset partition whose cpuset covers all logical cores of the 4 physical cores, including their hyperthread siblings (8 logical cores total). The partition reclaims these cores from the host scheduler, and processes outside the partition subtree, including system services and other containers, cannot be scheduled on them. This isolation is stronger than in ( Ma et al., 2026 ) , where containers are merely pinned to specific cores by affinity. However, this strategy constrains only the pinned processes. It cannot ensure that the container exclusively occupies the chosen cores; other processes may still land on them, especially on a multi-user server, making the measurement unstable and unreliable.

paragraphs.en: We first examine the statistical distinguishability between solutions with the F2P tests. Table 4 shows that, under the F2P tests, nearly half of the cases exhibit a statistically distinguishable difference between various fixes. This indicates that performance differences between model patches are fairly common. We also find that instruction count is more discriminative than wall-clock time, which is reasonable since wall-clock time is noisier than instruction count ( Peng et al., 2025b ) ; its within-solution variation is larger, and the resulting p p -values are correspondingly inflated. paragraphs.en: To analyze the difference between the p p -value and RSD, we further compare them case by case, as shown in Fig. 3 . paragraphs.en: To examine this phenomenon further, we pick an isolated point from the left end of the curve. paragraphs.en: Note that we have carefully merged different solutions. Existing work, by contrast, does not merge solutions before comparing runtime performance using RSD alone, so we argue that prior work may overlook differences that actually exist between solutions ( Peng et al., 2025b ) . Considering that prior work judges the quality of test scripts by RSD ( Peng et al., 2025b ) , namely that, on a given solution set, a higher RSD indicates a more effective and discriminative test instrument, we call on future work also to include Welch ANOVA, since it captures the genuine differences that RSD fails to reveal. paragraphs.en: We first examine each model’s runtime performance on the cases it resolved, comparing each model against the ground truth via the speedup (Table 6 ). Note that the models differ in the cases they resolved, so the comparison bases are not identical. Across the Scored columns, Claude attains the highest resolution rate throughout, on the full set and on the distinguishable subsets of both metrics. In terms of runtime performance, GPT, DeepSeek, and Claude all run faster than the ground truth on their own resolved cases, on the full set and the distinguishable subsets alike, while Qwen is consistently slower. Besides, for all models, the gaps to the ground truth become more pronounced on the distinguishable subsets (Table 6(b) ). On the win and loss counts, GPT and DeepSeek always win more cases than they lose against the ground truth in every data category; Claude always loses more cases than it wins even though its aggregate stays faster, which indicates that its winning cases speed up by a larger margin than its losing cases slow down; Qwen keeps its wins and losses roughly balanced, suggesting that its losing cases slow down by a larger margin than its winning cases speed up. Moreover, for GPT and DeepSeek, the win and loss counts far exceed the tie counts, with Claude in between, while for Qwen the three counts stay roughly equal, suggesting that Qwen and Claude tend to produce patches identical to the ground truth, consistent with the identity analysis in Fig. 2 .

sents.en: It fell back on LooseVersion when pkg_resources was unavailable, and carried a regular-expression sanitization that truncated a version string to its numeric prefix before comparing it with LooseVersion .
sents.zh: 当 pkg_resources 不可用时，它会退而使用 LooseVersion，并执行一个正则表达式清理操作，该操作会在与 LooseVersion 比较之前，将版本字符串截断至其数值前缀部分。

paragraphs.en: Initially, PR 7647 dropped heavy pkg_resources in favor of the light LooseVersion alone, halving the package import time from 0.28 to 0.16 seconds. During its review, a sanity check showed that LooseVersion successfully compares 3.0dev0 with 3.0dev1 , so the sanitizer was carelessly judged obsolete and removed in the same PR. The sanity check, however, did not cover the scenario where one version’s numeric components are compared with another’s string components, which the sanitizer had previously guarded against. The repository’s test suite also did not cover this situation. The careless removal therefore led to an error, so PR 7671 restored the sanitizer verbatim. The test in PR 7671 appends 0.12dev , shown in the first card of Fig. 5 , to compare against an installed version of 0.12.2 to expose this scenario. Semantically, 0.12dev is a development pre-release version of 0.12 and therefore precedes 0.12.2 ; the sanitizer realizes the comparison by truncating 0.12dev to 0.12 . Without it, LooseVersion raises a TypeError when comparing the last components of 0.12dev and 0.12.2 , namely dev and 2 . We refer readers to the two PRs for further details.

paragraphs.en: We now examine the three repair strategies the five sources produced, shown in the remaining cards of Fig. 5 . The ground truth and DeepSeek restore the sanitizer and stay on the lightweight LooseVersion parser. GPT and Qwen switch to the heavy pkg_resources parser unconditionally, while Claude keeps LooseVersion and falls back on pkg_resources when the former raises an error. Every patch passes the F2P test, but performance measurements separate them: the three strategies cost 48.8/103.4/64.9 billion instructions and 3.97/9.15/5.49 seconds, respectively. Overall, DeepSeek preserves the developer’s initial intent to remove the heavy dependency, while the others silently reintroduce it. The correctness tests cannot detect this architectural regression, which our performance analysis successfully reveals.

paragraphs.en: Internal validity. First, we use the F2P test as the unit of execution and assume the data-preparation and assertion phases cost the same across all correct solutions for a case. However, some patches may occasionally alter the cost of these two phases, contaminating the performance signal. Our method cannot detect this contamination. Second, necessary repeated executions of F2P tests introduce another possibility: only a fraction of the invocations truly execute the repair-relevant code, while later ones merely read the state left behind, so measurements degenerate to indistinguishable tiny values, reducing the discrimination among solutions. We acknowledge these limitations.

paragraphs.en: External validity. Our findings depend on the corpus scope. First, we filter the benchmarks down to a measurable corpus. The filtering is restrictive but entirely deterministic, built on reproducible static rules and dynamic analysis, and should be generalizable. Second, both benchmarks draw from Python repositories. In future work, we will extend the measurement to languages more sensitive to performance, such as C and C++. Third, all solutions come from a single SWE-agent framework, so patch diversity stems mainly from the models rather than the agent framework. Nevertheless, our analysis covers human-written ground-truth patches, which broadens the comparison. We plan to include more frameworks, such as OpenHands.

paragraphs.en: SWE-bench packages real issues from real-world repositories, and resolving them demands long-horizon reasoning ( Jimenez et al., 2024 ) ; SWE-bench-Live refreshes the pool with post-cutoff pull requests to reduce contamination ( Zhang et al., 2026 ) . Agentic systems supply the machinery, from SWE-agent’s agent-computer interface ( Yang et al., 2024 ) to the OpenHands platform ( Wang et al., 2025 ) . The stack closes with a boolean verdict on whether the patch passes. We build on them and measure the runtime behavior of patches the verdict discards, using the benchmarks’ built-in tests.
paragraphs.zh: SWE-bench 包含了来自真实世界代码库的实际问题，解决这些问题需要长期推理（Jimenez 等人，2024）；SWE-bench-Live 通过引入截止日之后的拉取请求来更新问题池，以减少数据污染（Zhang 等人，2026）。 智能体系统提供了相应的工具支持，从 SWE-agent 的智能体-计算机接口（Yang 等人，2024）到 OpenHands 平台（Wang 等人，2025）。 整个流程最终以一个布尔值判定补丁是否通过。 我们在这些工作基础上进一步研究，并利用基准测试中内置的测试来测量那些被判定为失败的补丁在运行时的行为表现。

paragraphs.en: This study empirically analyzed the runtime performance of patches produced by LLM agents on repository-level issue-resolution benchmarks, using the benchmarks’ built-in F2P tests as the workload. On the verified splits of SWE-bench and SWE-bench-Live, filtering for measurability left 339 instances, and 262 cases contained at least two genuinely different patches from four frontier models and the developer. We measured different solutions for each case on instruction counts and wall-clock times, and found that the built-in F2P tests carry genuine discrimination signal. Under Welch ANOVA, at most 42% of cases show statistically distinguishable differences among their different correct patches. The distinguishable subsets the Welch ANOVA identifies are highly consistent with the full corpus for model comparisons. The measurement shows that issue resolution rate and runtime performance are two independent dimensions of model capability, with nearly reversed orderings. We call for future work to consider the performance of the LLM-generated patches in addition to issue resolution rate.

paragraphs.en: The case’s two solutions come from Claude and the ground truth and share the same one-line core fix, which turns the zero test of the expression domain from a structural comparison into a symbolic one. In this case, we find clear bimodality in replicate costs, driven by per-process randomness. The test constructs a constant polynomial over a nested-radical expression and asserts it equal to the zero polynomial; under the patched zero test, the evaluation delegates to SymPy ’s assumption engine. Unable to decide the zero test structurally, the engine falls back to sign determination via minimal-polynomial computation and polynomial factorization over the integers. This mechanism carries per-process randomness, so repeated executions fall into one of two modes whose costs differ by about 2 × \times . Since each replicate is a fresh process, repeated executions of the same solution mix fast and slow runs, and the 36% within-solution RSD is precisely this bimodal mixture. The two solutions differ only by luck of the draw ; in our measurements, the model patch took the slow path in 1 of its 5 replicates, and the ground truth in 2 of 5, and this small difference alone produces a considerable between-solution RSD of 10.8%. Considering the between-solution spread solely, RSD would read the case as a large genuine difference. The case is doubly unsuited for performance comparison: its measurement is unstable, and its two solutions hardly differ. The p p -value weighs the between-solution spread against the within-solution noise, correctly declares the case indistinguishable, and removes it from the distinguishable subsets.
paragraphs.zh: 该案例的两个解决方案分别来自 Claude 和基准真值，且共享相同的单行核心修复方法：它将表达式域的零测试从结构比较转变为符号比较。 在此案例中，我们观察到重复执行成本存在明显的双峰分布，这是由每个进程内部的随机性所导致的。 该测试在一个嵌套根式表达式上构建一个常数多项式，并断言其等于零多项式；在修复后的零测试机制下，求值过程会委托给 SymPy 的假设引擎。 由于无法通过结构分析确定零测试结果，该引擎转而通过最小多项式计算和整数域上的多项式因式分解来确定符号。 这一机制带有进程内部的随机性，因此重复执行时会落入两种模式之一，其成本差异约为 2 × \times。 由于每次重复执行都是一个新的进程，同一解决方案的多次运行会混合快速和慢速的执行过程，而解决方案内部 36% 的相对标准差（RSD）正是这种双峰混合的结果。 这两个解决方案的差异仅取决于随机性；在我们的测量中，模型补丁在其 5 次重复执行中有 1 次走入了慢路径，而基准真值则有 2 次，仅这一微小差异就导致了 10.8% 的显著解决方案间 RSD。 如果仅考虑解决方案间的离散程度，RSD 会将该案例视为一个较大的真实差异。 该案例在性能比较方面存在双重不适宜性：其测量结果不稳定，且两个解决方案几乎没有任何差异。 p 值将解决方案间的离散程度与解决方案内的噪声进行权衡，正确地判定该案例无法区分，并将其从可区分的子集中排除。
